hero.title: Red de Misiones Mundiales is a global alliance of churches and believers that coordinates efforts and resources to bring practical help and spiritual hope to communities in need around the world.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.subtitle: We dream big, we act with purpose

missionaries.title: ✦ 2,500 Cross-Cultural Missionaries
missionaries.text: We dream of mobilizing 2,500 cross-cultural missionaries in our generation.

churches.title: ✦ 15,000 Transformative Churches
churches.text: We envision 15,000 churches in Argentina projecting themselves locally, nationally, and cross-culturally, impacting society and carrying the message to the ends of the earth.

verse.text: Therefore, go and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit. Teach these new disciples to obey all the commands I have given you.

efficiency.title: Efficiency
efficiency.text: Cooperation that maximizes gifts, skills, and resources that God has given us, growing in unity and solidarity.

effectiveness.title: Effectiveness
effectiveness.text: Final result: vital and reproductive churches with integral gospel in every ethnicity on earth.

relationship.title: ✦ Relationship
relationship.description: Sharing experiences and learning from others to perfect models.

cooperation.title: ✦ Cooperation
cooperation.description: Working together in everything that leads us to fulfill the Great Commission.

verse.text: So, my dear brothers and sisters, be strong and immovable. Always work enthusiastically for the Lord, for you know that nothing you do for the Lord is ever useless.

mobilization.title: ✦ Mobilization
mobilization.description: Encouraging churches, agencies, training centers, pastors and missionaries to mobilize other churches with vision and projects.

modelCreation.title: ✦ Model Creation
modelCreation.description: Developing cooperation models among pastors, agencies, centers and ministries, reviewing and projecting the biblical paradigm of cooperation.

whatdo.title: How do we do it?
whatdo.subtitle: Some of the activities carried out by the RMM
whatdo.textCard1: The RMM is divided into REGIONS that cover the entire country. We invite you to participate in your region by contacting its representative. By clicking here you can access information about the regions and contact details.
whatdo.textCard2: In addition, the Network is made up of FORUMS, which serve in different areas of the mission. Contact the coordinators of each forum to collaborate and participate.
whatdo.textCard3: La RMM colabora con diversas organizaciones para llevar a cabo su misión. Si deseas más información sobre cómo trabajar juntos, no dudes en contactarnos.
